summary: The superb torsional rigidity of the WK-59-2350 elevation tripod series is matched by its support strength (150 lbs., 68 kg).
specs: The WK-59-2350 has a load capacity of 150 lbs. (68 kg) with a maximum height of 72” and a minimum height of 33.5”.
The tripod weighs 23 lbs. with a maximum spread of 73” (185 cm).
It has a foot plate diameter of 4” (10 cm) for self-leveling and a 5/8” hole for spiking.
Also available in a shorter height (WK-59-2330) with a maximum height of 57” and a minimum height of 26”.
title: WK 59-2350 Elevation Tripod
